sections.title: Gorse form and flowering
sections.text: The plate depicts gorse (Ulex, likely U. europaeus): a densely branched, evergreen, very spiny shrub with yellow pea-shaped flowers. In common gorse the flowers are about 2 cm long, and the shrub can reach 1.5–2.5 m in height and spread.

sections.title: Seeds and use
sections.text: The sources describe the shrub’s flowering and ecological uses but do not establish a human food use, so this genus entry makes no edibility claim. Ulex includes multiple species, so size and distribution differ.
